name: AutomationExercise CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "develop", "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "develop", "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      suite:
        description: "Select TestNG Suite to execute"
        required: true
        default: "smoke.xml"
        type: choice
        options:
          - smoke.xml
          - api-suite.xml
          - regression.xml

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 25
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: "25"
          distribution: "temurin"
          cache: "maven"

      - name: Run TestNG Suite
        run: |
          SUITE_FILE="${{ github.event.inputs.suite || 'smoke.xml' }}"
          mvn clean test -DsuiteXmlFile=$SUITE_FILE -Dheadless=true

      - name: Upload Extent & Surefire Reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-execution-reports
          path: |
            target/surefire-reports/
            reports/
          retention-days: 7
